custom_instruments.manage.delete

Deletes a custom instrument.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.delete.

delete(universe: str, extended_params: ExtendedParams = None, session: Session = None) -> Response

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe str Yes Instrument symbol in the format "S)someSymbol.YOURUUID".
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
session Session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Example

from lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage import delete
response = delete("MyInstrument")
